about.hero.title: Why Receipters?
about.hero.subtitle: Welcome to Receipters – The Future of Receipts
about.hero.description: In a world where cluttered drawers and lost receipts are still common, Receipters brings simplicity, security, and smart technology to the way receipts are handled. Our mission is to eliminate paper waste, streamline digital receipting, and empower users with secure, real-time access to their transactions—anytime, anywhere.
about.values.subtitle: Our Core Values
about.values.title: What Drives Receipters
about.values.description: We believe in building a digital future where every receipt is more than a record—it's a resource. Our values guide how we create, connect, and innovate for businesses and individuals alike.
about.values.simplicity.title: Simplicity
about.values.simplicity.description: Our user-friendly interface makes managing receipts effortless for everyone.
about.values.efficiency.title: Speed
about.values.efficiency.description: Get instant access to your receipts, no waiting required.
about.values.security.title: Security
about.values.security.description: Your data is protected with military-grade encryption for peace of mind.
about.values.sustainability.title: Sustainability
about.values.sustainability.description: Reduce paper waste and help the environment with our digital solutions.
about.problem.title: Solving a Global Problem
about.problem.description1: Paper receipts are expensive, wasteful, and inconvenient. Receipters replaces them with smart, digital alternatives—cutting costs, reducing environmental waste, and improving customer experience.
about.problem.description2: Our dual model—Software-as-a-Product (SaaP) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)—serves both vendors and end-users, delivering security, accessibility, and efficiency across the board.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.description: Paper receipts are expensive, wasteful, and inconvenient. Receipters replaces them with smart, digital alternatives—cutting costs, reducing environmental waste, and improving customer experience.
about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.description: We're called Receipters because our goal is to turn paper receipts into digital ones. Our team of professionals believes that paper receipts aren't convenient for long-term use. They create storage issues, they fade over time and become unreadable, and they pose a security risk if they fall into the wrong hands.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.description: To empower businesses and individuals with seamless eco-friendly and cost efficient digital receipting solutions that promote transparency, efficiency, and sustainability in everyday life transactions.
about.vision.africa: To be Africa's leading digital receipting platform driving towards a paperless economy while saving costs,protecting the environment, and fostering financial inclusion.
about.team.title: Meet the Team
about.team.description: A passionate, experienced team of engineers, strategists, and technologists shaping the future of digital receipts.

product.hero.title: Receipters Products
product.hero.description: A complete suite of smart, secure, and scalable digital receipt tools for individuals and businesses.
product.features.title: What Receipters Offers
product.features.subtitle: Explore our powerful suite of tools and features
Automatically generate and send digital receipts via email, SMS, or to Receipters accounts.
product.features.offlineFunctionality.de:
Receipt Storage turns Receipters into your single source of truth for receipts. All digital
receipts, and any legacy paper receipts scanned via the app, are stored in a secure,
centralized vault.
Merchants and customers can quickly ﬁnd what they need using ﬂexible search tools –
without digging through folders, ﬁles, or boxes.
product.features.multiDeviceSync.descrip: The Receipters App is the front door to the Receipters Vault. It gives both merchants and consumers a simple, mobile-first way to capture, view, and manage receipts in real time.
product.features.budgetingAssistant.desc: Data Analysis is the intelligence layer on top of your Receipters Vault. Once your receipts are flowing in and securely stored, our analytics engine and AI Agent help you understand what's really happening in your business – in real time.
product.features.expenseSharing.title: Receipt Sharing
product.features.expenseSharing.descript: Share receipts with family, friends, or colleagues for returns, warranties, or record-keeping.
product.features.vendorAnalyticsDashboar: Vendors access real-time analytics on receipts, customer behavior, and transaction patterns.

product.aiBenefits.title: How Receipters' Technology Transforms Your Receipts
product.aiBenefits.description: Our intelligent system organizes, secures, and helps you access your digital receipts instantly.
product.aiBenefits.smartCategorization.d: Automatically organizes receipts based on merchants, dates, and purchase types.
product.aiBenefits.trendDetection.title: Quick Search
product.aiBenefits.trendDetection.descri: Find any receipt instantly with powerful search functionality and smart filters.
product.aiBenefits.instantRetrieval.desc: Access your receipts from any device, anytime, with cloud synchronization.
product.howItWorks.title: How It Works
product.howItWorks.step1.title: Step 1 – Capture
product.howItWorks.step1.description:
Receipts are generated digitally from POS or SoftPOS, captured as high-resolution
images via the Receipters App, or received from integrated channels like e-commerce
and delivery apps.
product.howItWorks.step2.title: Step 2 – Structure & Store
product.howItWorks.step2.description:
Our engine extracts and structures line-item data—merchant, outlet, products,
quantities, taxes, totals, payment methods, timestamps—and stores it in the
Receipters Vault as clean, standardized data.
product.howItWorks.step3.title: Step 3 – Search & Retrieve
product.howItWorks.step3.description: Users access, sort, search, and reference their receipts anytime.
product.howItWorks.step4.title: Step 4 – Analyse & Act (Optional)
product.howItWorks.step4.description: Everyone wins: fast, paperless, eco-friendly transactions.

product.cta.description: Start using Receipters today to manage your receipts like a pro.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Receipters ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our application and services. Please read this policy carefully to understand our practices regarding your personal information.
privacyPolicy.section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
privacyPolicy.section1.intro: We collect various types of information to improve our services, personalize user experience, and provide necessary functionalities. This includes:
privacyPolicy.section1.personalInfo.name: Name
privacyPolicy.section1.personalInfo.bill: Billing Information (including payment card details and billing address, processed securely by third-party payment processors)
privacyPolicy.section1.personalInfo.cred: User Credentials (for account creation and authentication purposes)
privacyPolicy.section1.financialData.tra: Transaction Data: Information on purchases, amounts, dates, locations, and merchant details from receipts.
privacyPolicy.section1.financialData.pay: Payment Integration Data (if connected): Credit card details and transaction records to sync purchase history.
privacyPolicy.section1.deviceInfo.title: c. Device and Usage Information
privacyPolicy.section1.deviceInfo.detail: Device Details: Type of device, operating system, unique device identifiers, and browser type.
privacyPolicy.section1.deviceInfo.usage: Usage Data: Time and frequency of app usage, features accessed, crash data, and performance logs.
privacyPolicy.section1.location.title: d. Location Information
privacyPolicy.section1.location.descript: Precise or Approximate Location: With your permission, we may collect location data to provide relevant insights and improve user experience.
privacyPolicy.section1.cookies.title: e. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
privacyPolicy.section1.cookies.storage: Cookies and Local Storage: We use cookies to save your preferences and understand how you interact with our service.
privacyPolicy.section1.cookies.analytics: Analytics Data: Information collected through third-party analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) to track user behavior and improve our services.
privacyPolicy.section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
privacyPolicy.section2.intro: We may use the collected information for various purposes, including:
privacyPolicy.section2.accountManagement: Account Management: Creating and managing your account, verifying your identity, and providing customer support.
privacyPolicy.section2.transactionManage: Transaction Management: Organizing and categorizing purchase records for easy access and reporting.
privacyPolicy.section2.improvingServices: Improving Services: Analyzing usage data to enhance app functionality, develop new features, and ensure platform security.
privacyPolicy.section2.communications: Communications: Sending account-related notifications, updates on policies, marketing, and promotional materials.
privacyPolicy.section2.compliance: Compliance and Legal Obligations: To comply with laws, regulations, and legal requests, and to prevent fraud or misuse of our services.
privacyPolicy.section3.title: 3. How We Share Your Information
privacyPolicy.section3.intro: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following circumstances:
We may share information with trusted third-party vendors (e.g., payment processors, cloud storage providers) that assist in our operations.
privacyPolicy.section3.legalCompliance.d: We may disclose information if required by law, or in response to valid legal requests from authorities.
privacyPolicy.section3.businessTransfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, user information may be transferred as part of the transaction.
privacyPolicy.section4.title: 4. Data Security
privacyPolicy.section4.description: We implement robust security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, and loss, including encryption, regular security audits, and access controls. However, no internet-based service is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyPolicy.section5.title: 5. Data Retention
privacyPolicy.section5.description: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy or as required by law. You may request deletion of your information at any time by contacting us at dpo@receipter.com.
privacyPolicy.section6.title: 6. Your Rights and Choices
privacyPolicy.section6.access: Access and Correction: You can access and update your personal information within your account settings.
privacyPolicy.section6.deletion: Deletion: You may request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal requirements.
privacyPolicy.section6.portability: Data Portability: You may request a copy of your data in a commonly used format.
privacyPolicy.section6.consent: Withdraw Consent: Where consent is required for data collection, you may withdraw it at any time by adjusting your settings.
privacyPolicy.section7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
privacyPolicy.section7.description: Our services are not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you become aware of any data collected from a child under 13, please contact us immediately at dpo@receipter.com.
privacyPolicy.section8.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.section8.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Effective Date" above. You are advised to review this policy periodically for any updates.
privacyPolicy.section9.title: 9. Contact Us
privacyPolicy.section9.intro: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
privacyPolicy.conclusion: This Privacy Policy outlines how Receipters prioritizes your privacy, ensuring transparency and accountability in handling your personal information.
